data.title: Creative Shape and Color Patterns
data.description: Learn how to build your own repeating patterns using wonderful shapes and colors.

challenges.instruction: Can you design your own repeating pattern using red and blue tokens?
challenges.hint: Try using two different colors and repeat them in the same order!
challenges.narration: Let us start by creating a simple repeating pattern using two colors.

challenges.instruction: Build a new pattern using circle and square shapes that repeats nicely.
challenges.hint: Think about repeating a group like one shape and two of another!
challenges.narration: Now let us try making a pattern with shapes where one unit repeats.

challenges.instruction: Create a pattern with three different colors: green, yellow, and red.
challenges.hint: Make sure your three chosen colors keep repeating in the exact same order.
challenges.narration: Time for a fun challenge! Let us use three different colors in our pattern.

challenges.instruction: Build a repeating pattern using a star and a triangle shape.
challenges.hint: Try repeating pairs of shapes to make your pattern grow!
challenges.narration: You are doing great! Let us make a pattern using pairs of shapes.

challenges.instruction: Design a longer, creative pattern mixing both colors and shapes!
challenges.hint: Pick a color and a shape and alternate them all the way to the end.
challenges.narration: This is our final challenge! Show off your pattern building skills.
